ValidationRule.description: When there is valid Actual_delivery_date then Status should be 'Shipped'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( NOT( ISNULL( Actual_Delivery_Date__c ) ) ,
OR ( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Requested"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Approved"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Declined"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Reopened"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Closed") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status should be shipped,Purchased or Returned for valid Actual delivery date
